title: Jamaican Jerk Stew
description: A flavorful and spicy stew originating from Jamaica, made with a variety of meats and vegetables.
instructions: Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the Jamaican Jerk Seasoning and cook for 1 minute.
Add the chopped onions and bell peppers and cook until tender.
Add the chopped chayote squash and cook for 5 minutes.
Add the can of diced tomatoes, vegetable broth, and stew leaf.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes.
Warm the flour tortillas by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with warm flour tortillas.
